The '''Georges Matheron Lecture Series'''<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.iamg.org/special-lectures/matheron-lecturer.html |title=Matheron Lecturer |publisher=IAMG |date=2014-02-23 |accessdate=2014-08-23 |archive-date=2014-08-09 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20140809084159/http://www.iamg.org/special-lectures/matheron-lecturer.html |url-status=live }}</ref> is sponsored by the [[International Association for Mathematical Geosciences]] (IAMG) to honor the legacy of the French [[engineer]] [[Georges Matheron|Georges François Paul Marie Matheron]], known as the founder of [[geostatistics]] and a co-founder (together with [[Jean Serra]]) of [[mathematical morphology]].<ref>{{cite book |url=https://www.springer.com/statistics/statistical+theory+and+methods/book/978-0-387-20331-7 |title=Space, Structure and Randomness:Contributions in Honor of Georges Matheron in the Fields of Geostatistics, Random Sets and Mathematical Morphology Series |publisher=Lecture Notes in Statistics, Vol. 183, 2005, XIV, p.402, Springer Book |isbn=9780387203317 |year=2005 |series=Lecture Notes in Statistics |access-date=2017-08-28 |archive-date=2013-08-26 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20130826045912/http://www.springer.com/statistics/statistical+theory+and+methods/book/978-0-387-20331-7 |url-status=live }}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.geosociety.org/awards/04speeches/04DIV_awards.pdf |title=2004 Medals and Awards |publisher=Geological Society of America, page 9 |access-date=2019-08-29 |archive-date=2018-09-26 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180926235304/http://www.geosociety.org/awards/04speeches/04DIV_awards.pdf |url-status=live }}</ref> The Georges Matheron Lecture was established in 2005 and is given by a scientist with proven research ability in the field of [[spatial statistics]] or [[mathematical morphology]].<ref>{{cite web |title=Matheron Lecturer |url=https://iamg.org/awards-and-honours/matheron-lecturer/#:~:text=The%20Lectures%20Committee%20seeks%20nominations,spatial%20statistics%20or%20mathematical%20morphology.}}</ref> It is presented annually if an eligible and worthy nominee is found. The first recipient of the award was [[Jean Serra]], for a long time a scientists with the  [https://web.archive.org/web/20140803222024/http://cmm.ensmp.fr/index_eng.html Centre of Mathematical Morphology, Fontainebleau].  Serra delivered the first lecture at the IAMG conference in Liège, [[Belgium]] in 2006.<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.iamg.org/documents/Newsletters/NewslettersHSP/NL73%20low%20res.pdf |title=Matheron Lecturer, p. 8, IAMG Newsletter 73 |publisher=IAMG |access-date=2014-09-28 |archive-date=2015-09-24 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150924032204/http://www.iamg.org/documents/Newsletters/NewslettersHSP/NL73%20low%20res.pdf |url-status=live }}</ref> The IAMG Lectures Committee seeks nominations and makes the selection.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://iamg.org/information-about-iamg/statutes-and-bylaws.html|title=Statutes and Bylaws|website=Iamg.org|accessdate=9 September 2018|archive-date=31 August 2018|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180831002431/https://iamg.org/information-about-iamg/statutes-and-bylaws.html|url-status=live}}</ref>
